thread:
alex: Quick note — ensemble-int8 canary produced NDJSON funcall stream where array order flips intermittently when using streaming+prefix_cache. Sample below.

priya: sample?

alex: Here's the stream fragment we received (two NDJSON lines):
```json
{\"tool\":\"rank\",\"args\":{\"items\":[\"a\",\"b\",\"c\"]}}
{\"tool\":\"rank\",\"args\":{\"items\":[\"c\",\"b\",\"a\"]}}
```
Parser passes each line but downstream we expect stable item order for deterministic eval; flip happens ~1/250 calls.

yuan: Interesting. Do you mean the model returned two lines for the same call or the stream got duplicated with different orders?

alex: Two lines in the same streaming response — first line correct, later line appears as a retry/resume fragment with reordered array. Likely streaming resume logic replays cached prefix then appends live tokens out of order.

dev-bot: canary-job-1777771234 running on sandbox-int8-05. metrics: duplicate_line_rate=0.4%, ndjson_order_flip=0.15% (baseline 0.00%).

priya: Can you paste raw bytes for the boundary where second line starts?

alex: Sure:
```
... 0x7d 0x0a 0x7b 0x22 0x74 0x6f 0x6f 0x6c ...
```
Looks normal. But token-id trace shows an extra prefix-resume token sequence inserted before finishing previous line.

yuan: Low-cost repro: enable prefix_cache + small batch_size=1 + inject simulated network resume. If flip reproduces, suspect resume concat logic.

priya: Short-term mitigation: when NDJSON lines contain arrays we can run a deterministic canonicalizer for list-valued args during lint (sort when items are known-idempotent?). Risky. Safer: add validation that rejects duplicate lines in same response unless purposeful. Emit telemetry tag `ndjson_duplicate_detected`.

alex: For root cause: capture token-id pre-concat traces, bisect streaming-resume commits, run mirror with prefix_cache off.

dev-bot: started mirror job canary-1777771234/prefix-off on sandbox-int8-06. ndjson_order_flip=0.0%.

yuan: That nails prefix_cache interaction. Plan: (1) opt-in duplicate suppression + telemetry (priya), (2) add unit tests for resume concat ordering (yuan), (3) do bisect on resume handler (alex). Filed ML-ONBOARD-3120. Will keep this thread.
